//notes: Each value is the MAX acceptable lava/node wall-time ratio (lava is allowed to be up to Nx Node's time). A benchmark with no entry in caps and no entry in report_only fails `make bench-gate` (agent-cycle F1.2 — silent discovery shrinkage). Calibrated 2026-07-11 against the perf/buffer tip (observed ratio x ~1.5-2 headroom for CI noise); re-run `make bench` and tighten further as the ratios improve.

caps.//encoding: Added 2026-07-27 with bench/micro/encoding.js. The absolute ratios are high because the non-fastpath decoders do their per-byte work in JS against Node's fully native ICU/C++ codecs (since 2026-07-28 the accumulator's string-building does end in one native utf16le crossing, but the per-byte loop is still JS); the caps catch a REGRESSION, they do not claim parity. Caps are ~1.4x the typical ratio on a quiet box. decode-win1252 has NO cap on purpose (report-only): its measured run-to-run spread reaches 2.26x under load, larger than the ~1.43x effect a cap would exist to catch, so no value separates signal from noise - a light that fires on one clean run in four and misses the regression 40% of the time trains reviewers to re-run. decode-utf8-stream keeps 17.0: widening it to 19.0 was measured to cost detection (100% -> 66-91%) without removing the false positives it was meant to fix (22% still trip 19.0 under heavy load), i.e. a middle position worse than either end. On a breach, re-run and compare MEDIANS of >=3 launches before believing it: median-of-3 cuts the loaded-box false-positive rate from ~24% to ~16% with detection unchanged at 100%. Since 2026-07-28 the gate does this itself - `--gate` takes the median of 3 launches per side (bench/run.mjs, collectMedian); report-only runs still take one, since they fail nothing. Recalibrated 2026-07-28 after the Uint16Array-accumulator/native-utf16le rewrite (fatal/utf16le/chunked -> 16.5/14.5/9.5). Recalibrated 2026-11-15 (#362): decode-utf16le widened 14.5 -> 17.5 because across 8 `make bench-gate` runs (median of 3 launches per side) recorded in #362 it measured 11.07x, 14.01x, 14.44x, 14.63x, 15.22x, 15.61x plus 2 passes (~14.3x median, breaching 14.5x in 3 of 8 runs; 4-core ubuntu-latest CI 1-launch runs 43719701306/43725488015/43742288199/43743582297 measured 4.61x, 9.29x, 9.02x, 8.94x under Node v24.22.2 vs bin/lava -o:speed). decode-win1252-tiny is report-only like decode-win1252: it exists to make a tiny-input regression visible (measured 0.98x - the native crossing wins even at 8 bytes), and its fixed-cost path is too noisy to gate.
caps.//url: Added 2026-07-30 with bench/micro/url.js. Recalibrated 2026-11-15 (#362, #403) before enabling `make bench-gate` in CI, after url.js primordials hardening (118c8b5, 5466d59, 2f43897). Measured across 4 ubuntu-latest 4-core CI single-launch runs (runs 43719701306, 43725488015, 43742288199, 43743582297; Node v24.22.2 vs bin/lava -o:speed): url-parse-special 15.24x, 16.84x, 17.20x, 18.45x; url-parse-octal 7.00x, 8.45x, 8.62x, 8.67x; url-relative 6.64x, 7.12x, 7.19x, 7.28x; plus 2 shared-container runs in #403 (median-of-3 `make bench-gate` at cf850ca and 1-launch `make bench` at 49bc489, Node 24.22.1 vs bin/lava -o:speed): special 23.53x/26.69x, relative 9.99x/11.16x, octal 11.47x. Caps give headroom above both environments (special 16.0 -> 28.0, octal 11.4 -> 13.5, relative 7.9 -> 12.0). Do not re-pin to reduce variance; run.mjs records that pinning shifts the level 25-40%.
caps.//urlsearchparams: sp-parse at ~26-40x is construction cost; lookup is fast (0.62x-0.90x in the 4 ubuntu-latest 4-core CI runs listed above, 0.98x median-of-3 in #403, 1.00x in #336 after url.js primordials hardening). Widened urlsearchparams-get 0.9 -> 1.5 (#336, #362) so CI and unpinned dev runs do not flake at 0.9x-1.0x while still catching multi-fold lookup regressions.
